verification.before_consumption: Verify exact archive SHA256 and detached signature with isolated keyring; require the listed primary signer. Reject changed bytes, other signers or invalid/missing signatures before extraction/configure.
verification.ncurses_checksum_source: Computed from archive after successful upstream signature verification.
verification.identity_limit: Fingerprints associated through official HTTPS publication; no independent web-of-trust identity assurance.
verification.extraction: Reject absolute paths, traversal and non-data members; require expected release root and bounded member/count/expanded sizes.

zsh.target_only: --enable-libc-musl only with actual pinned Aether musl
zsh.module_rule: After configure, preserve zsh/main fields except clear functions. Select zle/complete/compctl link=static auto=no load=yes. Set every other row link=no auto=no load=no. All rows end with unquoted functions=. Do this before first make; use make prep if changing an already-built configuration.
zsh.functions: none installed; no compinit corpus, plugins or startup scripts
zsh.environment: Exact finite fixture HOME/PATH/cwd/TERM and real UTF-8 locale; no inherited TERMINFO/TERMINFO_DIRS/TERMCAP/TERMPATH or loader/module paths.
zsh.optional_curses_selection: zsh_cv_ignore_ncurses=yes: disable optional full-curses discovery; pass the exact authenticated build libtinfo.a path in LIBS. Actual termcap function checks remain enabled. This selects an omitted feature, not API success.

ncurses.selected_library: static libtinfo.a; termcap compatibility API, compiled terminfo reader
ncurses.database: One frontend-compatible TERM entry and transitive use= closure, compiled by host tic from the same authenticated release. Frontend/entry selection and inherited notices must be reviewed before native execution.
ncurses.search: Disable home lookup; set explicit target terminfo directory; sanitize environment. No database-free fallback.

native_requirements.requirements: isatty, ttyname/open or actual read-write TTY fd duplication, fcntl F_GETFL/F_GETFD/F_SETFD and CLOEXEC, libc allocation/stdio/errno/environment/identity lookup/locale; truthful lookup failure; no invented account database. Independent stdin/stdout/stderr bindings and terminal handle authority.
native_requirements.oracle: Interactive ZLE is truly active, no surprise startup reads; fd alias/close semantics and denied authority observable.

native_requirements.requirements: Real tcgetattr/tcsetattr(TCSADRAIN); ICANON/ECHO and selected signal/control/input/output flags, VMIN/VTIME; poll/select/read with EOF, EAGAIN, EINTR and deadlines; winsize; terminal restoration. ZLE mode is specific termios transformation, not unconditional generic raw.
native_requirements.oracle: Cursor editing/backspace, fragmented escape sequences, timeout, EOF/disconnect, resize and exit restoration with no echoed duplicate input.

native_requirements.requirements: tgetent/tgetflag/tgetnum/tgetstr, tgoto/tputs and output callback; authenticated selected compiled terminfo readable via bounded FS authority; controlled lookup paths; padding/delay path requires honest timing if selected capabilities use it.
native_requirements.oracle: Selected TERM capabilities match frontend; missing/unknown TERM explicit fallback or failure, no fabricated full-screen capability.

native_requirements.requirements: cwd, path resolution, opendir/readdir/closedir, stat and access; PATH command enumeration and bounded directory data. Namespace visibility and execute authorization remain distinct.
native_requirements.oracle: One granted filename completes; denied directory/foreign scope does not leak names; type/permission and nonexistent path results truthful.

native_requirements.requirements: setlocale, mbrtowc/wcrtomb, isw*/tow*, wide string/memory functions and width calculation. Explicit --enable-multibyte bypasses automatic completeness inference: verify target symbols and semantics. Select real UTF-8 locale and compatible terminal width behavior.
native_requirements.oracle: Fragmented multibyte input, delete/backspace one codepoint, combining/wide character redisplay, invalid sequence and bounded incomplete-sequence timeout.

native_requirements.requirements: fork, argv/env execve, pipes/dup/fcntl/close, wait; authorized immutable executable acquisition and correct denied/notfound/ENOEXEC handling. Script fallback attempts /bin/sh; missing interpreter is a real failure, not automatic authority.
native_requirements.oracle: One pinned helper status and descriptor inheritance, then finite pipeline/substitution/redirection tiers; rejected exec leaves prompt and resources intact.

native_requirements.requirements: sigaction, masks/sigsuspend, SIGCHLD, wait stopped/continued status, process groups, tcgetpgrp/tcsetpgrp, group-scoped kill, Ctrl-C/Z foreground routing and SIGTTIN/TTOU; real elapsed-time APIs for selected waits/jobs, never diagnostic fixed UTC.
native_requirements.oracle: Foreground helper Ctrl-C, stopped helper Ctrl-Z/jobs/bg/fg, exact statuses and foreground restoration; denied foreign/stale group; bounded cleanup.

application_profile_scope: Owner-approved distinct resource trial under issue69; no native qualification or guest. Old ordinary profile remains unchanged.
